_comment: Where each night is spent. HAND-MAINTAINED - no script writes here. Keyed by the town name in build_data.STOPS, not by day, because a hotel is the end of one day and the start of the next: writing it once means the two can never disagree. 'address' is shown as-is; 'lat'/'lon' drive the map marker and the map links, and are what the day page measures its 'x ft from the finish' against. A town with no entry simply shows no card for that night: Los Altos because day 1 starts from home. Leave a town out until its hotel is confirmed, and do not fill one in from a map lookup in the meantime - an unconfirmed address published as fact is worse than a blank, and the blank is what prompts somebody to go and confirm it.
